entities.summary: Daniel Carr is a Canadian professional ice hockey forward for the Milwaukee Admirals of the American Hockey League (AHL). Originally undrafted by teams in the National Hockey League (NHL), Carr has previously played for the Montreal Canadiens, Vegas Golden Knights, Nashville Predators, and Washington Capitals.
